dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage with multi-immune in vivo CAR therapy approach. Company has dosed first patient in their lead program MT-304.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First patient dosed in Phase 1/2 study of MT-304 targeting HER2-positive solid tumors as of April 2026. No specific efficacy or safety data disclosed in available sources.
dossier.indications_pursued: HER2-positive solid tumors with lead candidate MT-304. No additional indications specified in available data.
dossier.delivery_approach: Multi-immune in vivo platform encompassing CAR-T, CAR-NK, and all-RNA RetroT technologies. Specific delivery mechanism not detailed in available sources.
dossier.key_differentiators: Multi-immune approach combining CAR-T, CAR-NK, and all-RNA RetroT platforms in single in vivo system. First-in-class positioning for multi-immune in vivo CAR therapy.
dossier.last_significant_event: First patient dosed in Phase 1/2 study of MT-304 for HER2-positive solid tumors in April 2026. Company showcased platform at AACR 2026 conference.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company with in vivo gene editing approach using their Gene Writing platform.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1/2 trial (NCT07227207) for TSRA-196 in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency with PiZZ genotype is registered but not yet recruiting.
dossier.indications_pursued: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD) with lung and/or liver disease manifestations, and sickle cell disease in preclinical development.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo delivery platform for both gene editing applications and CAR-T cell generation directly in patients.
dossier.key_differentiators: Gene Writing platform technology that enables in vivo CAR-T applications, potentially eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 announcement of new preclinical data presentations in sickle cell disease and in vivo CAR-T at ASGCT meeting.
Addition Therapeutics announced multiple oral and poster presentations at the ASGCT 29th Annual Meeting in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapies. Currently has one recruiting Phase 1 trial (NCT06528301) evaluating UB-VV111 in B-cell lymphomas.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Limited disclosed data available, with Phase 1 dose-escalation study of UB-VV111 currently recruiting patients. No published clinical results or detailed efficacy data reported to date.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and multiple myeloma. Focus appears to be on B-cell cancers and plasma cell disorders.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology, with UB-VV500 described as a dual-target approach for multiple myeloma. Specific delivery mechanism details not disclosed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Dual-target CAR-T approach as evidenced by UB-VV500 program for multiple myeloma. In vivo delivery eliminates need for ex vivo cell manufacturing and patient apheresis procedures.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 announcement of UB-VV500 dual-target in vivo CAR-T data presentation at American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy Annual Meeting. Multiple news outlets covered the unveiling of this multiple myeloma program.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with asset CPTX2309 currently recruiting in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, focusing on moderate to severe disease presentations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06917742 for CPTX2309 in healthy volunteers and rheumatoid arthritis patients, currently in recruiting status.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with in vivo CAR-T technology. Currently recruiting patients for their lead asset KLN-1010.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Phase 1 trial (NCT07075185) evaluating safety, tolerability, and recommended Phase 2 dose of KLN-1010 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients. No specific efficacy or safety data disclosed in available sources.
dossier.indications_pursued: Multiple myeloma, specifically targeting relapsed or refractory patient populations.
dossier.delivery_approach: In vivo CAR-T platform technology. Specific delivery mechanism for KLN-1010 not detailed in available data.
dossier.last_significant_event: Acquisition by Eli Lilly for $7 billion in April 2026, described as the largest in vivo CAR-T deal to date.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapies delivered via direct injection. Currently has 4 clinical trials initiated, with at least one actively recruiting patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: Targeting hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Also pursuing refractory autoimmune diseases with dual CD19/BCMA targeting approach.
dossier.delivery_approach: Direct injection platform for in vivo CAR-T delivery using assets JY231 for B-cell malignancies and JY232 for multiple myeloma. Utilizes dual CD19/BCMA targeting for autoimmune indications.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on in vivo CAR-T generation through direct injection rather than ex vivo cell manufacturing. Dual targeting approach combining CD19 and BCMA antigens for autoimmune disease treatment.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with two assets (HN2301 and HN2302) being tested in autoimmune diseases. Multiple Phase 1 trials are active or planned for systemic lupus erythematosus, myasthenia gravis, and scleroderma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including generalized myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma/systemic sclerosis. One trial for refractory myasthenia gravis was terminated.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 trial NCT06801119 for HN2301 in systemic lupus erythematosus and scleroderma, which is currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T approaches using both viral and non-viral vector delivery systems.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells independent of double-stranded DNA breaks, as reported in Nature.
dossier.indications_pursued: Cancer indications and autoimmune diseases including systemic rheumatic diseases and autoimmune disorders.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach utilizing both viral vectors and non-viral delivery systems for in vivo CAR-T cell engineering.
dossier.key_differentiators: Non-viral targeted integration technology that operates independently of double-stranded DNA breaks. Nanotechnology-enhanced delivery strategies to address manufacturing complexity and solid tumor efficacy limitations.
dossier.last_significant_event: Publication in Nature (April 2026) demonstrating non-viral targeted integration of large DNA in primary human T cells.

dossier.delivery_approach: Non-viral cell therapy approach in partnership with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI through a Center of Excellence.
dossier.last_significant_event: Established Center of Excellence with Kytopen and Fraunhofer IZI for advanced non-viral cell therapies in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Preclinical stage with in vivo CAR-T cell engineering using TRAC platform technology.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: First-in-primate data for in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering presented at ASGCT Annual Meeting in May 2026.
dossier.delivery_approach: TRAC platform for direct in vivo T cell engineering and CAR-T generation.
dossier.key_differentiators: In vivo CAR-T cell engineering approach that directly modifies T cells in the body rather than requiring ex vivo manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: Late-breaking oral presentation at ASGCT Annual Meeting demonstrating first-in-primate in vivo TRAC-CAR T cell engineering data in May 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical development with lead asset EN-374 for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease currently recruiting patients.
dossier.indications_pursued: X-linked chronic granulomatous disease with EN-374 as the lead program, plus broader chronic granulomatous disease research activities.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 trial NCT06876363 evaluating EN-374 in X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, currently recruiting participants.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage with ex vivo CAR-T programs (SC262, SC291) and preclinical in vivo CAR-T development (SG293). Company operates dual modalities with both traditional CAR-T and emerging in vivo CAR-T approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data from in vivo CAR-T program SG293 presented at ASGCT 2026, representing the most advanced disclosed dataset. Clinical trials for SC262 and SC291 are active but no results reported yet.
dossier.indications_pursued: Oncology indications including Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma, Large B-cell Lymphoma, and Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia. Autoimmune diseases including Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and Type 1 diabetes.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach combining traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapy and in vivo CAR-T delivery technology. Hypoimmune cell therapy platform also mentioned for diabetes applications.
dossier.key_differentiators: Development of in vivo CAR-T technology alongside traditional ex vivo approaches, potentially eliminating need for patient cell collection and manufacturing. Hypoimmune cell platform targeting metabolic diseases like Type 1 diabetes.
dossier.last_significant_event: Oral presentation of preclinical data from in vivo CAR-T program SG293 at ASGCT 2026 Annual Meeting in April 2026.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 stage with intramuscular delivery approach for solid tumor asset EVM14.
dossier.indications_pursued: Selected solid tumors (EVM14), primary membranous nephropathy (EVER001), and primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (Nefecon).
dossier.delivery_approach: Intramuscular administration for EVM14, with oral delivery for BTK inhibitor EVER001.
dossier.key_differentiators: EVER001 is described as a highly selective, oral, reversible, covalent BTK inhibitor with high selectivity over other kinases.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1/2 trial NCT07095868 for EVM14 in selected solid tumors, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1 clinical stage company developing in vivo CAR-T cell therapy using lipid nanoparticles encapsulating circular RNA encoding CD19 CAR.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Currently recruiting patients for Phase 1 dose escalation study (NCT07413341) in relapsed/refractory autoimmune diseases including SLE and Sjogren's syndrome.
dossier.indications_pursued: Autoimmune diseases including systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and Sjogren's syndrome for relapsed and refractory patients.
dossier.delivery_approach: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) targeting T cells that encapsulate circular RNA encoding CD19 chimeric antigen receptor.
dossier.key_differentiators: Uses circular RNA technology delivered via targeted lipid nanoparticles to generate CAR-T cells in vivo, eliminating need for ex vivo cell manufacturing.
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of Phase 1 clinical trial NCT07413341 for in vivo CAR-T therapy in autoimmune diseases, currently recruiting patients.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical stage company developing conventional ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies, not in vivo approaches.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: No clinical data disclosed yet from three ongoing Phase 1/2 trials for OriCAR-017 in multiple myeloma and Ori-C101 in hepatocellular carcinoma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with anti-GPRC5D CAR-T (OriCAR-017) and advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with GPC3-directed CAR-T (Ori-C101).
dossier.delivery_approach: Traditional ex vivo CAR-T cell manufacturing and infusion approach using modified T cell injections.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on solid tumor CAR-T applications including hepatocellular carcinoma targeting GPC3, alongside hematologic malignancies.
dossier.last_significant_event: $110 million pre-IPO funding round completed in April 2026 to advance solid tumor CAR-T pipeline.

dossier.stage_and_modality: Phase 1/2 clinical development with ex vivo CAR-T cell therapies across multiple solid tumor indications.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: CT041 (anti-CLDN18.2 CAR-T) in Phase 1b/2 trials for gastric adenocarcinoma and pancreatic cancer, with one product (Zevorcabtagene Autoleucel) advancing to Phase IV post-marketing studies for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
dossier.indications_pursued: Solid tumors including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and hepatocellular carcinoma, plus hematologic malignancies (relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma).
dossier.delivery_approach: Ex vivo autologous CAR-T cell manufacturing and infusion platform.
dossier.key_differentiators: Focus on solid tumor CAR-T applications with CLDN18.2 targeting approach and apparent commercial approval of at least one CAR-T product (Zevorcabtagene Autoleucel).
dossier.last_significant_event: Initiation of CT011 Phase Ib trial for hepatocellular carcinoma patients at risk of recurrence after surgical resection (NCT06560827, currently recruiting).

dossier.stage_and_modality: Early-phase clinical development with both in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T approaches. Company has Phase 1 trials ongoing for in vivo candidates IMV101 and IMV102, plus ex vivo CAR-T programs targeting CLDN18.2.
dossier.best_disclosed_data: Preclinical data for IMV102 presented at AACR 2026 demonstrated durable tumor control in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Clinical data from ongoing Phase 1 and Phase 3 trials has not yet been reported.
dossier.indications_pursued: Hematologic malignancies including relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma and multiple myeloma. Solid tumors focused on CLDN18.2-positive digestive system cancers including gastric adenocarcinoma, pancreatic cancer, and esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma.
dossier.delivery_approach: Dual platform approach with in vivo CAR-T candidates (IMV101, IMV102) and traditional ex vivo CAR-T therapies. Specific delivery mechanisms for in vivo candidates are not disclosed in available data.
dossier.key_differentiators: Developing both in vivo and ex vivo CAR-T modalities within a single company portfolio. IMV102 demonstrated durable tumor control in preclinical studies for multiple myeloma.
dossier.last_significant_event: April 2026 presentation of preclinical data for IMV102 at AACR demonstrating durable tumor control in multiple myeloma models.
